about: Full text of the core laws, parsed from the official PDFs in knowledge-base/source at seed time by ai-service/app/core/statute_parser.py. Each becomes a document of its own, current alongside the hand-checked extract of the same law in india.json, which keeps its own labels, source links and search aids. Edition notes say how current each file is; they are shown in the version tag.
